summary: Elmet Group Co. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 definitive investment agreement with the U.S. Department of War for a $450 million equity investment and commitments to expand domestic tungsten mining, processing, and manufacturing, including restart of the Springer APT plant and upgrades at Coldwater, Lewiston and Euclid. The DoW Transactions closed September 14, 2026. The filing also includes unregistered equity sales, rights modifications, officer changes, and bylaw amendments. No per-share price, stake percentage, premium, or advisor was disclosed; watch governance rights, dilution, and execution risk.
